mentions.name: Datafarm Studio
mentions.description: A web-based studio showcasing a pair of custom DSLs for data transformation and chart visualization that pair well together, with full LSP support in Monaco text editor npm packages sharing the same static analysis crate as the VS Code LSP client, and native GIS with GeoJSON and Shapefile support for both languages.
mentions.source_excerpt:
In the last few weeks I've been working on a couple of custom data transformation and chart visualization DSLs that pair well together, as you can see here:

https://williamcotton.github.io/datafarm-studio/
